result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue in the bottom navigation bar where missing safe-area inset padding causes the system home indicator to overlap the navigation icons.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar lacks bottom safe-area padding, causing the icons to sit flush against the bottom screen edge and the OS home indicator bar to directly overlap the search and orders icons.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area inset padding (e.g., env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) to the bottom navigation container so the icons sit cleanly above the system home indicator.
